source_review.notes: Checked Shannon's primary switching-circuit paper, Quine and McCluskey primary minimization papers, the active IEEE 1800-2023 SystemVerilog record, the official historical-status record for IEEE/ANSI 91a-1991, current publisher records for Harris and Harris and Weste and Harris, and the official Nand2Tetris site. The chapter date-qualifies standards status and does not claim that Boolean equivalence establishes physical implementation quality.

evidence: Checked B={0,1}, f:B^n->B^m, input/output vectors, on-set, off-set, care set and don't-care set notation.
Checked literals, minterms, maxterms, sum of products, product of sums, implicants and prime-implicant terminology.
Checked gate-network G=(V,E), acyclicity, depth, fan-in and fan-out definitions and their separation from physical delay.

notation_and_syntax.notes: Positive-logic Boolean values are explicitly separated from exact electrical voltage.

evidence: Confirmed a three-input domain has eight vectors and majority is true on four: 011, 101, 110 and 111.
Confirmed the executable performs 16 counted De Morgan comparisons and eight selector comparisons with zero NAND-majority mismatches.
Confirmed a 32-input domain has 4,294,967,296 vectors and one million vectors cover approximately 0.0233 percent, below 0.024 percent.
Confirmed a six-input 4-to-1 multiplexer exhaustive test requires 64 vectors.
Confirmed Exercise 1 output sequence 0,1,1,0,1,0,0,1 for odd parity.
numerical_recomputation.notes: Counts describe finite two-valued domains only.

evidence: Re-derived the canonical minterm construction and its exact on-set behavior.
Re-derived NAND NOT, AND and OR constructions and checked functional-completeness reasoning through canonical forms.
Checked both De Morgan identities, absorption, complement, identity, domination, idempotence and distributivity uses.
Derived selector, decoder, equality, majority and odd-parity expressions independently.
Checked the care-set equivalence statement forall x in C: implementation(x)=specification(x).
symbolic_recomputation.notes: Symbolic results establish functional relations under stable two-valued semantics, not temporal or electrical behavior.

boundary_and_adversarial_cases.notes: High-stakes acceptance, physical sign-off and regulated authorization remain named human-review obligations.

evidence: Checked every legal input has exactly one specified output and every equivalence claim names the care set.
Checked simplification preserves complete truth-table behavior, width, order and polarity.
Checked don't-care conditions require explicit specification ownership and are not equated with impossible inputs.
Checked modeled combinational networks remain acyclic and physical evidence is not inferred from logic depth.
Checked exhaustive evidence compares an independently expressed reference and implementation over the complete encoded domain.
invariant_checking.notes: Runtime assertions cover the encoded functions only; lint, synthesis, formal and physical sign-off are not executed.

evidence: Reviewed canonical sum-of-products existence proof row by row.
Reviewed NAND functional-completeness proof by constructive definitions of NOT, AND and OR.
Reviewed selector proof by exhaustive select cases and decoder one-hot proof by mutually exclusive exhaustive minterms.
Reviewed the static-1 hazard example and confirmed it is not presented as a timing proof for a physical implementation.
Confirmed exhaustive Python results are never presented as proof of electrical correctness, safety, security or specification adequacy.
proof_review.notes: Proofs are finite Boolean arguments relative to declared assumptions, not hardware certification.

evidence: Audited uses of prove, complete, exhaustive, equivalent, minimal, correct, safe, reliable, impossible and decisive.
Functional completeness is limited to expressibility; minimization requires a named cost model; equivalence is limited to the care set and modeled semantics.
Every high-consequence claim is reserved for system evidence and authorized human review, and no external academic, practitioner or regulatory review is claimed.
proof_sketch_labeling.notes: Universal wording is paired with explicit domain and semantic assumptions.

empirical_evidence_labeling.notes: Execution is exhaustive for the encoded small Boolean domains and empirical only with respect to the Python implementation.

conceptual_review.notes: The chapter cleanly separates value, level, function, expression, gate network and physical circuit; presents a specification-to-table-to-expression-to-network-to-equivalence chain; and preserves later modules' ownership of state, clocking, arithmetic, timing, power and processor structure.

practitioner_review.notes: Practice guidance covers interface bounds, canonical baselines, justified simplification, target mapping, structural checks, exhaustive or symbolic equivalence, don't-care governance, tool evidence, polarity, width and explicit escalation to physical sign-off.

pedagogical_review.notes: Objectives align with ten distinct examples and five exercises progressing from minterms and algebra through NAND completeness, reusable structures, exhaustive coverage limits, hazards and high-stakes assurance. The executable example supplies a compact independently checkable proof boundary.

limitations: Internal evidence record only; no external academic or practitioner review is claimed.
